<function name="AddToolMenuCategories" parent="SANDBOX" type="hook">
	<description>This hook is used to add new categories to spawnmenu tool tabs.</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
</function>

<example>
	<description>Adds default categories to Utilities tab in spawnmenu.</description>
	<code>
local function CreateUtilitiesCategories()

        spawnmenu.AddToolCategory( "Utilities", "User", "#spawnmenu.utilities.user" )
        spawnmenu.AddToolCategory( "Utilities", "Admin", "#spawnmenu.utilities.admin" )

end        
hook.Add( "AddToolMenuCategories", "CreateUtilitiesCategories", CreateUtilitiesCategories )
	</code>

</example>
